'''Synthglue''' was a type glue that could be used to bind things together.<ref name="inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Alema Rar]] used synthglue to attach a [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenade]] on a door in order to blast it open from a safe distance.<ref name="inferno" />
